name: Citizenship by Marriage (Simplified Naturalisation)

requirements.blocker_text: A foreign spouse (either gender -- the law applies without gender distinction) of a Kazakhstani citizen may apply for a simplified naturalization after being married for at least 3 years and permanently residing in Kazakhstan, in place of the standard 5-year residence requirement. Requires a notarized renunciation of any prior citizenship (Kazakhstan does not permit dual citizenship for this route), plus security screening, marriage certificate, and spouse's identity document.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 3 years of marriage and permanent residence, then apply with a notarized renunciation of prior citizenship.

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: permanent residence for the 3-year marriage period

sources.title: Electronic Government of the Republic of Kazakhstan (egov.kz) -- describes the simplified marriage-based naturalization track: 3 years' marriage/permanent residence (vs. the standard 5-year requirement), marriage certificate, spouse's ID, and notarized renunciation of prior citizenship

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Kazakhstan). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- direct e-government sourcing, tier 1. GENUINE POSITIVE FINDING, WORTH FLAGGING AGAINST THE PATTERN SEEN REPEATEDLY THIS SESSION: unlike Iran, Lebanon, Tunisia, Pakistan, Somalia, Ghana, and Tanzania's marriage-citizenship routes elsewhere in this dataset -- all of which are gendered, granting an automatic or streamlined path to a foreign WIFE only -- Kazakhstan's provision (Citizenship Law Article 16(1), cross-referenced via an NGO-hosted English translation at ecoi.net, tier 2) is written and applied without gender distinction: 'persons ... married to citizens of the Republic of Kazakhstan for at least three years,' with no separate or lesser treatment for a foreign husband of a Kazakhstani woman. This is still a naturalization application requiring security screening and mandatory renunciation of prior citizenship, not automatic acquisition -- Kazakhstan's own citizenship law states explicitly that 'marriage ... shall not entail the change of citizenship' on its own. dual_citizenship_allowed set false per the same strict prohibition and 3-day reporting/surrender rule noted in kz_citizenship_by_descent.json.
